preconditions: acct in SVIGG_BOOKING_ALLOWLIST (test acct by default).
execution_steps: Navigate calfilt to the target date (date-guarded).
Click the target grid cell to stage the slot server-side.
Fill cpt00 (REQUIRED — blank => silent 200 bounce), Duration00, note00.
POST bk_p with a FRESH parsed TFORMCOUNT; Submit=Submit (or Overbook on full slot).
Detect bounce (HTTP 200 + re-rendered form) vs accept (HTTP 302).
Date-guarded grid re-read to confirm the patient is on the target date.
selectors_needed: svigg: calfilt grid cell (x/y slot)
bk_p form fields (cpt00, Duration00, note00, Submit)

strong_match: emr_id (exact SIS patient_id or Svigg acct)

actions.success_condition: submitted_verified — a date-guarded grid re-read finds the patient on the target date.
actions.retry_behavior: on slot_full re-post with Submit=Overbook + Duration00; never re-POST with a stale TFORMCOUNT; never trust 'submitted' without a verified re-read.
actions.approval_requirements: human approval required; single-use approval token checked at the POST site; acct allowlist enforced.

post_action_verification.method: re-read the EMR after the write and confirm the change is really present (date-guarded grid re-read / chart re-read).
post_action_verification.screenshot_proof: capture a post-action screenshot + Playwright trace of the verified end-state (evidence.py) and attach ids.
post_action_verification.only_success_if: the re-read positively confirms the change; otherwise return status=failed or needs_human_review — NEVER trust the POST response alone.
